summary: Issue #356, uniting-cause premise. Materialized and reread AQUINAS-ST-I-Q3-A7 in full and pinned AQUINAS-ST-I-Q11-A1 in the existing q.11 snapshot (same blob 41e38b54, TEI id TAca84-d1e103-Dd1e137). The existing claim's 'interpretive step' (the uniting cause is a cause, other than the composite, of its being) is split into typed premises over the existing q.3 a.7 ComponentOf, the secunda via EfficientlyCausesIn and the quarta via CausesIn, plus a new Unites relation (DEF-UNITING-CAUSE, DISAMB-UNITING-CAUSE). Two distinct components come from q.11 a.1 (partes eius ... divisae); the uniting principle from q.3 a.7 tertio; uniter-is-efficient is the suppressed premise of tertio's appeal to God as first efficient cause; uniter-causes-being reads q.11 a.1 (no esse while the parts are divided) with tertio's identification of the composite's cause as the uniter. Distinctness c ≠ x is derived from the existing q.2 a.3 no-efficient-self-cause statement rather than assumed. The EXACT legacy CompositeHasAUnitingCauseReading is derived with zero axioms and Composite, CausesIn and esse left as parameters, so existing consumers are unchanged. Six Bool/Unit controls show each premise is needed and that the five are jointly satisfiable with a composite; the first also shows that the existing fifth-proof reading (one component other than itself) does not suffice. Rival location, not refutation: brute composition rejects the uniting principle; a self-uniting whole (priority monism's shape) rejects uniter-is-efficient or no-efficient-self-cause; composition without being-dependence (composition as identity, innocent fusion) rejects uniter-causes-being. Rejected: identifying EfficientlyCausesIn with CausesIn (DISAMB-CAUSE keeps them apart), a CausesIn irreflexivity read from q.3 a.4 'nulla res sufficit quod sit sibi causa essendi' (that sentence concerns sufficient self-causation, so the reading would strengthen it), and reading diversa as specific difference (the proof covers homogeneous wholes).
blocker: All five premises are open and sourced but undefended; STMT-COMPOSITE-HAS-A-UNITING-CAUSE stays one sourced leaf under the route-cost rule until all are closed. The two weakest readings are uniter-is-efficient (a suppressed premise of the reason) and uniter-causes-being (q.11 a.1 states only that the composite's esse requires the union). STMT-NO-COMPONENT-IS-FIRST-BEING and STMT-MATTER-FORM-AND-ESSE-ESSENCE-ARE-COMPOSITIONS were not touched. Independent defense against the three rival shapes, and actual presence of the uniter (DISAMB-UNITING-CAUSE-ACTUALITY), remain open.
